_README: FROZEN FIXTURE — the live response of GET /api/essentials/location-search?q=portland&limit=8,
captured 2026-10-26 through the dev proxy against api.empowered.vote.
🔴 THIS IS THE ROW SET THAT DISPROVES "a 7-digit geoid is a place".
Eight rows, and TWO of them are school districts with SEVEN-DIGIT geoids:
2312330  G5420  "South Portland Public Schools, ME · School District"
A school district geoid is state FIPS + a five-digit district code, so it is exactly the
same length as an incorporated place FIPS. Branching on length alone — which 17-03-PLAN.md
specified — would have offered "Portland Public Schools" as a CITY and keyed a civic space,
its banner, its officials and its Explore on a school district. Across sixteen sample
queries on the capture date, 23 of 118 rows were G5420 at seven digits; the other 82
seven-digit rows were G4110 places. searchRowKind therefore requires the geoid SHAPE and
the MTFCC to agree, and this fixture is the live proof of why.
It also carries the Portland OR / Portland ME pair, which is the reason banners.generated.ts
joins on path and never on a place name.
